title: The Elite vs. Death Triangle: best of seven
summary: A disputed trios-title match becomes a seven-match series built around Death Triangle’s use of a hammer.

chapters.title: Death Triangle win the first match
chapters.result: Fenix uses the hammer to pin Omega.
chapters.context: The disputed finish starts the series.

chapters.title: The Elite win match seven
chapters.result: The Elite win the ladder match and the trios championship.
chapters.context: Omega retrieves the deciding title belt.
